# CreateMy-QR - Comprehensive Developer and AI Documentation

> CreateMy-QR is a 100% Free, Privacy-First, Local-Processing QR Code Suite that operates entirely within the user's browser using advanced WebAssembly (WASM) and local client-side processing.

**Summary document:** https://createmy-qr.com/llms.txt

## Platform Overview
- **App Title**: Free QR Code Generator Online — No Signup, No Expiry, No Watermark
- **Tagline**: Create QR Codes with Logo & Color - Client-Side, Instant, Unlimited
- **Privacy Guarantee**: 100% Client-Side. No servers, no tracking, no 14-day trials, no scan limits. QR codes never expire.
- **Technology**: WebAssembly (WASM) + React + i18next (30 languages)
- **Compliance**: ISO/IEC 18004:2015 | GDPR | CCPA | WCAG 2.1 AA

## Advanced Technical FAQs

**Q: What QR code error correction levels does CreateMy-QR support?**
A: CreateMy-QR supports all four ISO/IEC 18004:2015 error correction levels: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), and H (30%). Level H is recommended when embedding a logo, as it ensures the code remains scannable even with up to 30% of the matrix obscured.

**Q: Does CreateMy-QR use any third-party QR libraries?**
A: The QR matrix encoding is implemented natively using WebAssembly compiled from an optimized C/C++ core. This ensures sub-100ms generation latency without any external API calls or cloud round-trips.

**Q: Can CreateMy-QR QR codes be scanned by all major QR readers?**
A: Yes. All generated codes strictly conform to ISO/IEC 18004:2015. They are tested against Apple iOS Camera, Android Camera, Google Lens, WeChat, Snapchat, and all major dedicated scanner apps.

**Q: What is the maximum data capacity of QR codes on CreateMy-QR?**
A: A QR Code version 40 (the maximum) with error correction level L can encode up to 7,089 numeric characters, 4,296 alphanumeric characters, or 2,953 bytes of binary data.

**Q: How does the Local History feature work?**
A: Generated QR codes are automatically saved to the browser's IndexedDB — a sandboxed, client-side database. The data is stored in the user's device only, is never transmitted to any server, and can be cleared at any time. Users can browse, search, and re-download any previously generated code.

**Q: Is CreateMy-QR compliant with GDPR?**
A: Yes, by architectural design. Since no personal data is ever transmitted to our servers (we have none for QR generation), there is nothing to comply with at the server level. The browser's own data storage policies and user consent govern the Local History feature.

**Q: What image formats are available for download?**
A: PNG (any custom resolution, transparent background supported) and SVG (infinitely scalable vector format, perfect for print, billboards, and product packaging).

## Supported Languages (30)
English, Indonesian, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Hindi, Korean, Arabic, Russian, Italian, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Vietnamese, Thai, Greek, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Romanian, Ukrainian, Malay, Filipino, Bengali.

## Platform Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 18 + Vite + TailwindCSS
- **Internationalization**: react-i18next with 30 locale files
- **QR Engine**: WebAssembly (WASM) — client-side only
- **Storage**: IndexedDB + LocalStorage (browser only, no cloud sync)
- **Hosting**: Vercel (Edge Network, 99.99% uptime SLA)
- **SEO**: Static Site Generation (SSG) for all 1,380+ localized pages
